<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="600.0" y="37" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="30" font-weight="700" text-anchor="middle" fill="#172336">
<tspan x="600.0" dy="0">Structured hop attention  |  Module overview</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="600.0" y="65" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="600.0" dy="0">Precomputed H / T8,H16,d_a12,hops3 / time Softmax / no mask in source  /  read bottom to top</tspan>
</text>
<rect xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="55.0" y="721" width="16" height="16" rx="3" fill="#f8d4e1" stroke="#263348" />
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="78.0" y="734" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="start" fill="#172336">
<tspan x="78.0" dy="0">Inputs</tspan>
</text>
<rect xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="240.0" y="721" width="16" height="16" rx="3" fill="#ffddb3" stroke="#263348" />
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="263.0" y="734" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="start" fill="#172336">
<tspan x="263.0" dy="0">Gate / attention</tspan>
</text>
<rect xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="425.0" y="721" width="16" height="16" rx="3" fill="#c8ebfb" stroke="#263348" />
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="448.0" y="734" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="start" fill="#172336">
<tspan x="448.0" dy="0">Conv / transforms</tspan>
</text>
<rect xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="610.0" y="721" width="16" height="16" rx="3" fill="#c9f1cd" stroke="#263348" />
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="633.0" y="734" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="start" fill="#172336">
<tspan x="633.0" dy="0">Gates / Softmax</tspan>
</text>
<rect xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="795.0" y="721" width="16" height="16" rx="3" fill="#dfdff8" stroke="#263348" />
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="818.0" y="734" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="start" fill="#172336">
<tspan x="818.0" dy="0">Linear / outputs</tspan>
</text>
<rect xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="980.0" y="721" width="16" height="16" rx="3" fill="#cdeaf8" stroke="#263348" />
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="1003.0" y="734" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="start" fill="#172336">
<tspan x="1003.0" dy="0">Tensor operations</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="600.0" y="762" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="600.0" dy="0">B=batch; supplied H:[B,8,16]; r3 hops; attention:[B,3,8].</tspan>
<tspan x="600.0" dy="16.52">Source lacks padding masking; each hop normalizes over sequence positions.</tspan>
<tspan x="600.0" dy="16.52">Classifier and embedding/LSTM producer are outside the selected boundary.</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="600.0" y="866" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="600.0" dy="0">Reviewed static source + selected profile. Repeated groups are templates; shapes are not runtime observations.</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="600.0" y="896" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="600.0" dy="0">E### = source span; dashed = side / shape dependencies; fork/join roles are typed in IR; no implicit sum.</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="600.0" y="921" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="600.0" dy="0">Repeated colors encode operation roles. Shared weights and independent instances are recorded in semantic_ir.json.</tspan>
</text>
